body:
## Pull request overview

Adjusts the mobile E2E performance benchmark threshold to reduce CI flakiness under CPU throttling, keeping the mobile performance gate meaningful while accommodating slower CI environments.

**Changes:**
- Increased the mobile page-load performance budget from 5000ms to 7000ms.
- Added an inline comment explaining the CI-driven rationale and the prior threshold.

The PR title/description indicate the 7000ms budget is meant for CI only, but this change increases the budget unconditionally for all environments. Consider keeping the stricter local/dev threshold and switching to a higher budget only when `process.env.CI` (or a Playwright config setting) is set, so regressions are caught earlier outside CI.

This assertion times `page.goto(..., { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' })`, so the measured value is time-to-DOMContentLoaded rather than a full page load. The updated comment says "Page should load" which is a bit misleading; either adjust the comment to reflect DOMContentLoaded, or change the navigation wait condition to match the intent of the budget.
